chip.description: Memory mapper: programmable address decoding and banking for the 68000 bus on Sega System 16B, System 18, System 24 and X-Board (taxonomy §4.5 example).
chip.notes: Identified as "memory mapper" in the custom-parts table of src/mame/sega/segaic16.cpp in MAME 0.288 and in the Guru PCB notes in src/mame/sega/segas16b.cpp ("315-5195 - Custom Sega IC (PGA135)").
